goal: Investigate model mismatch within a bounded thermal experiment budget.

revision_semantics.register_revision: Stage a provisional fitted candidate for testing, not acceptance or causal identification.
revision_semantics.confirmation: To test a fitted candidate: register_revision first, then propose_experiment on its returned model_id with kind confirmation.
revision_semantics.verdict: Only measured confirmation supports or rejects a staged revision on that tested input.

decision.rationale: Numerical comparison before physical experiments: sensor_lag provisional fit shows lowest training RMSE 0.076C and BIC -1807 vs linear RMSE 0.299C BIC -834 and quadratic_loss RMSE 0.299C BIC -823 on initial-0, initial-1, initial-2; fitting is not confirmation or causation.

Fitted comparison on initial-0, initial-1, initial-2 shows sensor_lag RMSE 0.077C vs linear/quadratic ~0.299C, but fit is not confirmation; propose staggered diagnostic to independently probe initial model dynamics within budget.

result.note: Explicit preparation and dispatch through Investigation are required

decision.rationale: Numerical comparison before further physical experiments: prior fits on initial-0,initial-1,initial-2 favored sensor_lag training RMSE 0.077C vs linear/quadratic ~0.299C; refit including action-2 which showed no_mismatch_observed RMSE 0.081C to compare explanations; fitting is not confirmation or causation.

action-2 staggered probe showed no_mismatch_observed probe RMSE 0.081C, but passing does not certify unseen schedules and training fits are not confirmation; propose opposed-levels diagnostic to independently probe initial model dynamics within remaining budget.

decision.rationale: Numerical comparison before consuming 2 remaining experiments: action-2 RMSE 0.081C and action-4 RMSE 0.077C both no_mismatch_observed on initial model, prior sensor_lag fit BIC -2407 vs linear -834; refit including action-4 to compare explanations; fitting is not confirmation or causation.

action-2 RMSE 0.081C and action-4 RMSE 0.077C both no_mismatch_observed on initial model, but passing does not certify unseen schedules; sensor_lag training fit RMSE 0.078C BIC -3023 is not independent confirmation; propose alternate diagnostic to probe initial model within 2 remaining experiments.
